// Command interop checks svage against the reference age implementation
// (filippo.io/age v1.3.2) in both directions, and writes reference-made
// files for svage's tests.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/ecdh"
	"crypto/hpke"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/rsa"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/pem"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"filippo.io/age"
	"filippo.io/age/agessh"
	"filippo.io/age/armor"
	"filippo.io/age/plugin"
	"filippo.io/age/tag"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/ssh"

	"github.com/codemodify/secretvault/svage"
)

var plaintext = bytes.Repeat([]byte("secretvault and age agree.\n"), 40)

const ed25519Key = `-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAABG5vbmUAAAAEbm9uZQAAAAAAAAABAAAAMwAAAAtzc2gtZW
QyNTUxOQAAACB/aTuac9tiWRGrKEtixFlryYlGCPTOpdbmXN9RRmDF2gAAAKDgV/GC4Ffx
ggAAAAtzc2gtZWQyNTUxOQAAACB/aTuac9tiWRGrKEtixFlryYlGCPTOpdbmXN9RRmDF2g
AAAECvFoQXQzXgJLQ+Gz4PfEcfyZwC2gUjOiWTD//mTPyD8H9pO5pz22JZEasoS2LEWWvJ
iUYI9M6l1uZc31FGYMXaAAAAG2ZpbGlwcG9AQmlzdHJvbWF0aC1NMS5sb2NhbAEC
-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
`

const (
	tagSeed   = "svage interop p256tag"
	tagPQSeed = "svage interop mlkem768p256tag"
)

func main() {
	switch os.Args[1] {
	case "gen":
		must(gen(os.Args[2]))
	case "check":
		must(check())
	}
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "FAIL:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func refEncrypt(path string, armored bool, rs ...age.Recipient) error {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	var dst io.Writer = &buf
	var aw io.WriteCloser
	if armored {
		aw = armor.NewWriter(&buf)
		dst = aw
	}
	w, err := age.Encrypt(dst, rs...)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	w.Write(plaintext)
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if aw != nil {
		aw.Close()
	}
	return os.WriteFile(path, buf.Bytes(), 0o644)
}

func tagIdentity(pq bool) (hpke.PrivateKey, *tag.Recipient) {
	if pq {
		k, _ := hpke.MLKEM768P256().DeriveKeyPair([]byte(tagPQSeed))
		r, err := tag.NewHybridRecipient(k.PublicKey().Bytes())
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		return k, r
	}
	k, _ := hpke.DHKEM(ecdh.P256()).DeriveKeyPair([]byte(tagSeed))
	pub, _ := ecdh.P256().NewPublicKey(k.PublicKey().Bytes())
	_ = pub
	// Compress the point: 0x02|0x03 by y's parity, then x.
	u := k.PublicKey().Bytes()
	c := append([]byte{2 | u[64]&1}, u[1:33]...)
	r, err := tag.NewClassicRecipient(c)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return k, r
}

func gen(dir string) error {
	os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755)
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "ssh-ed25519.key"), []byte(ed25519Key), 0o600); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	edID, err := agessh.ParseIdentity([]byte(ed25519Key))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := refEncrypt(filepath.Join(dir, "ssh-ed25519.age"), false, edID.(*agessh.Ed25519Identity).Recipient()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := refEncrypt(filepath.Join(dir, "ssh-ed25519-armored.age"), true, edID.(*agessh.Ed25519Identity).Recipient()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rk, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	blk, err := ssh.MarshalPrivateKey(rk, "svage interop")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "ssh-rsa.key"), pem.EncodeToMemory(blk), 0o600); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rsaID, _ := agessh.NewRSAIdentity(rk)
	if err := refEncrypt(filepath.Join(dir, "ssh-rsa.age"), false, rsaID.Recipient()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, tr := tagIdentity(false)
	if err := refEncrypt(filepath.Join(dir, "p256tag.age"), false, tr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, tpq := tagIdentity(true)
	if err := refEncrypt(filepath.Join(dir, "mlkem768p256tag.age"), false, tpq); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "recipients.txt"), []byte(fmt.Sprintf(
		"# The tag recipients the reference encrypted to: HPKE DeriveKeyPair of %q and %q.\n%s\n%s\n",
		tagSeed, tagPQSeed, tr, tpq)), 0o644)
}

// refTagIdentity opens tagged stanzas the way age's own test identity does,
// using the reference's tag computation.
type refTagIdentity struct {
	k  hpke.PrivateKey
	r  *tag.Recipient
	pq bool
}

func (i *refTagIdentity) Unwrap(ss []*age.Stanza) ([]byte, error) {
	typ, label := "p256tag", "age-encryption.org/p256tag"
	if i.pq {
		typ, label = "mlkem768p256tag", "age-encryption.org/mlkem768p256tag"
	}
	for _, s := range ss {
		if s.Type != typ || len(s.Args) != 2 {
			continue
		}
		tg, _ := svDecode(s.Args[0])
		enc, _ := svDecode(s.Args[1])
		want, err := i.r.Tag(enc)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(tg, want[:4]) != 1 {
			return nil, errors.New("tag mismatch")
		}
		rc, err := hpke.NewRecipient(enc, i.k, hpke.HKDFSHA256(), hpke.ChaCha20Poly1305(), []byte(label))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return rc.Open(nil, s.Body)
	}
	return nil, age.ErrIncorrectIdentity
}

var base64Raw = base64.RawStdEncoding.Strict()

func svDecode(s string) ([]byte, error) {
	b, err := base64Raw.DecodeString(s)
	return b, err
}

func svEncrypt(armored bool, rs ...svage.Recipient) ([]byte, error) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	var dst io.Writer = &buf
	var aw io.WriteCloser
	if armored {
		aw = svage.NewArmorWriter(&buf)
		dst = aw
	}
	w, err := svage.Encrypt(dst, rs...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	w.Write(plaintext)
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if aw != nil {
		aw.Close()
	}
	return buf.Bytes(), nil
}

func refDecrypt(name string, file []byte, armored bool, ids ...age.Identity) error {
	var in io.Reader = bytes.NewReader(file)
	if armored {
		in = armor.NewReader(in)
	}
	r, err := age.Decrypt(in, ids...)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: reference Decrypt: %v", name, err)
	}
	out, err := io.ReadAll(r)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(out, plaintext) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: reference read: %v", name, err)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok  svage -> age ", name)
	return nil
}

func svDecrypt(name string, file []byte, armored bool, ids ...svage.Identity) error {
	var in io.Reader = bytes.NewReader(file)
	if armored {
		in = svage.NewArmorReader(in)
	}
	r, err := svage.Decrypt(in, ids...)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: svage Decrypt: %v", name, err)
	}
	out, err := io.ReadAll(r)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(out, plaintext) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%s: svage read: %v", name, err)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok  age -> svage ", name)
	return nil
}

func check() error {
	// X25519, both ways, and key encodings both ways.
	rx, _ := age.GenerateX25519Identity()
	sx, err := svage.ParseX25519Identity(rx.String())
	if err != nil || sx.String() != rx.String() || sx.Recipient().String() != rx.Recipient().String() {
		return fmt.Errorf("X25519 encodings differ: %v", err)
	}
	sr, _ := svage.ParseRecipient(rx.Recipient().String())
	f, err := svEncrypt(false, sr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := refDecrypt("X25519", f, false, rx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var rf bytes.Buffer
	w, _ := age.Encrypt(&rf, rx.Recipient())
	w.Write(plaintext)
	w.Close()
	if err := svDecrypt("X25519", rf.Bytes(), false, sx); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Hybrid.
	rh, _ := age.GenerateHybridIdentity()
	sh, err := svage.ParseHybridIdentity(rh.String())
	if err != nil || sh.String() != rh.String() || sh.Recipient().String() != rh.Recipient().String() {
		return fmt.Errorf("hybrid encodings differ: %v", err)
	}
	gh, _ := svage.GenerateHybridIdentity()
	if _, err := age.ParseHybridIdentity(gh.String()); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("the reference cannot parse an svage hybrid identity: %v", err)
	}
	if f, err = svEncrypt(true, sh.Recipient()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := refDecrypt("hybrid, armored", f, true, rh); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rf.Reset()
	w, _ = age.Encrypt(&rf, rh.Recipient())
	w.Write(plaintext)
	w.Close()
	if err := svDecrypt("hybrid", rf.Bytes(), false, sh); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// scrypt.
	sp, _ := svage.NewScryptRecipient([]byte("correct horse"))
	sp.SetWorkFactor(12)
	if f, err = svEncrypt(false, sp); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rp, _ := age.NewScryptIdentity("correct horse")
	if err := refDecrypt("scrypt", f, false, rp); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rf.Reset()
	rrp, _ := age.NewScryptRecipient("correct horse")
	rrp.SetWorkFactor(12)
	w, _ = age.Encrypt(&rf, rrp)
	w.Write(plaintext)
	w.Close()
	sip, _ := svage.NewScryptIdentity([]byte("correct horse"))
	if err := svDecrypt("scrypt", rf.Bytes(), false, sip); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// SSH keys: svage encrypts, the reference decrypts, and back.
	signer, err := ssh.ParsePrivateKey([]byte(ed25519Key))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	edRcpt, err := svage.ParseSSHRecipient(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(signer.PublicKey())))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	edRef, _ := agessh.ParseIdentity([]byte(ed25519Key))
	if f, err = svEncrypt(false, edRcpt); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := refDecrypt("ssh-ed25519", f, false, edRef); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	edSv, err := svage.ParseSSHIdentity([]byte(ed25519Key), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rf.Reset()
	w, _ = age.Encrypt(&rf, edRef.(*agessh.Ed25519Identity).Recipient())
	w.Write(plaintext)
	w.Close()
	if err := svDecrypt("ssh-ed25519", rf.Bytes(), false, edSv); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	rk, _ := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
	rsaRef, _ := agessh.NewRSAIdentity(rk)
	rsaPub, _ := ssh.NewPublicKey(&rk.PublicKey)
	rsaRcpt, err := svage.ParseSSHRecipient(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(rsaPub)))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if f, err = svEncrypt(false, rsaRcpt); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := refDecrypt("ssh-rsa", f, false, rsaRef); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	// Tags: svage encrypts, a reference-computed tag must match.
	for _, pq := range []bool{false, true} {
		k, r := tagIdentity(pq)
		str, err := svage.ParseTagRecipient(r.String())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if str.String() != r.String() {
			return fmt.Errorf("tag recipient encodings differ")
		}
		if f, err = svEncrypt(false, str); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := refDecrypt(fmt.Sprintf("tag (post-quantum: %v)", pq), f, false, &refTagIdentity{k: k, r: r, pq: pq}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	// Mixing: the reference refuses what svage refuses.
	if _, err := svage.Encrypt(io.Discard, sh.Recipient(), sx.Recipient()); err == nil {
		return errors.New("svage mixed post-quantum and classical recipients")
	}

	// Plugin identity encoding.
	enc, err := svage.EncodePluginIdentity("secretvault", []byte("default/age/laptop"))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	name, data, err := plugin.ParseIdentity(enc)
	if err != nil || name != "secretvault" || string(data) != "default/age/laptop" {
		return fmt.Errorf("the reference reads the plugin identity as %q %q: %v", name, data, err)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok  plugin identity encoding", enc)
	return nil
}
